meta.name: Africa
meta.description: All African STEM & Physics universities, radio astronomy arrays (MeerKAT/SKA), biomedical & climate centers, and historical milestones.

eras.label: Pre-Classical & Ancient Foundations
eras.summary: Quantitative astronomy, metrology, optics, statics, hydrostatics, and naturalistic cosmology across Mesopotamia, Egypt, India, China, and the Mediterranean.

eras.label: Golden Ages & Medieval Optics
eras.summary: Experimental optics, magnetism, algebra of motion, and precision observatories across the Islamic Golden Age, Song China, India, and medieval Europe.

eras.label: Scientific Revolution
eras.summary: Heliocentrism, telescopic astronomy, laws of planetary motion, universal gravitation, calculus, and analytical mechanics.

eras.label: Electromagnetism & Thermodynamics
eras.summary: Unification of electricity, magnetism, and light; statistical entropy; X-rays; and the discovery of radioactivity.

eras.label: Relativity & Quantum Century
eras.summary: Spacetime curvature, quantum mechanics, nuclear physics, QED, semiconductor electronics, cosmic microwave background, and the Standard Model.

eras.label: Precision & Mega-Experiments
eras.summary: High-Tc superconductors, Bose-Einstein condensates, neutrino mass, dark energy, graphene, Higgs boson, gravitational waves, black hole imaging, and fusion ignition.

eras.label: Upcoming Frontier (2027–2045+)
eras.summary: Next-generation compact and burning-plasma fusion, 39 m optical telescopes, gigaton neutrino observatories, space interferometers, and post-LHC colliders.

hubs.name: MeerKAT / SKA-Mid
hubs.summary: 64 gleaming white radio dishes spread across the silent Karoo desert, forming the heart of the Square Kilometre Array.
hubs.nobel: Tests Einstein's general relativity using millisecond binary pulsars.

stages.highschool: SARAO Schools Programme & Karoo astronomy outreach.
stages.undergrad: SARAO Undergraduate Bursaries & NASSP honours prep.
stages.masters: NASSP / SARAO MSc bursaries + open MeerKAT data via UCT, Oxford & Manchester.
stages.phd: Funded SKA / MeerKAT PhDs in radio astronomy and pulsar timing.
stages.postdoc: SARAO / SKAO Postdoctoral Fellowships in Cape Town or Manchester.
stages.prof: SARAO / SKAO Science Leadership & Research Chairs.

hubs.name: Ghana Radio Astronomy Observatory
hubs.summary: West Africa's flagship 32-meter radio telescope converted from a telecommunications dish—anchoring the African VLBI Network (AVN) alongside the University of Ghana.
hubs.nobel: First SKA African partner country outside South Africa to operate a converted VLBI radio observatory.

stages.highschool: PRAGSAC & Ghana Space Science and Technology Institute (GSSTI) outreach.
stages.undergrad: University of Ghana BSc Physics & DARA (Development in Africa with Radio Astronomy) training.
stages.masters: MPhil in Physics / Astrophysics with DARA & SARAO scholarships.
stages.phd: Joint African-European PhD tracks in radio interferometry and pulsar science.
stages.postdoc: AVN / SARAO visiting fellowships linking Kuntunse with MeerKAT and EVN.
stages.assoc_prof: Senior Lecturer at University of Ghana / GSSTI Observatory Scientist.
stages.prof: African VLBI Network (AVN) & SKA Africa leadership.

hubs.name: University of Nairobi Physics
hubs.summary: East Africa's leading university physics department, advancing laser spectroscopy, condensed matter, solar photovoltaics, astrophysics, and nuclear instrumentation.
hubs.nobel: Key node of the African Laser Centre and Kenya's SKA/AVN astronomy initiative.

stages.highschool: Kenya Science & Engineering Fair and University of Nairobi astronomy club.
stages.undergrad: BSc in Physics, Astronomy & Astrophysics, or Microprocessor Instrumentation.
stages.masters: MSc in Physics supported by ISP (Uppsala) and DAAD East Africa fellowships.
stages.phd: Funded doctoral tracks in laser physics, photovoltaics, and astrophysics.
stages.postdoc: ICTP / ISP / African Laser Centre postdoctoral exchanges.
stages.assoc_prof: Associate Professor in Department of Physics (Chiromo Campus).
stages.prof: Chair of Physics & East African Regional Science Consortia.

hubs.name: ICTP-EAIFR Kigali
hubs.summary: UNESCO Category 2 partner institute of Abdus Salam ICTP hosted at the University of Rwanda—training a new generation of African physicists in HEP, condensed matter, and geophysics.
hubs.nobel: Modeled directly on ICTP Trieste to elevate fundamental physics across Sub-Saharan Africa.

stages.highschool: East African Physics outreach & open online lecture series.
stages.undergrad: Regional preparatory schools in theoretical and computational physics.
stages.masters: Fully funded 2-year English MSc in High Energy, Condensed Matter, or Geophysics.
stages.phd: Funded PhD tracks co-supervised with ICTP Trieste and global partners.
stages.postdoc: ICTP-EAIFR Visiting & Postdoctoral Research Fellowships in Kigali.
stages.assoc_prof: EAIFR Resident Faculty & ICTP Regular Associates.
stages.prof: Institute Director & African Strategy for Fundamental and Applied Physics (ASFAP) chairs.

projects.name: ICTP-EAIFR Postgraduate Physics & HPC Training Program

hubs.name: African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS South Africa)
hubs.summary: Africa's first pan-African network of centers of excellence in mathematical sciences—founded by cosmologist Neil Turok in Muizenberg and now spanning South Africa, Senegal, Ghana, Cameroon, and Rwanda.
hubs.nobel: Trained 3,000+ African master's graduates from 45+ countries; home to the African Master's in Machine Intelligence (AMMI) backed by Google & Meta.

stages.highschool: Engage with AIMSSEC teacher enrichment programs strengthening school mathematics across Africa.
stages.undergrad: Prepare for the fully funded AIMS Structured Master's Programme in Mathematical Sciences.
stages.masters: 1-year intensive residential MSc (100% scholarships) taught by visiting professors from around the world.
stages.phd: AIMS-South Africa & Quantum Leap Africa PhD tracks in data science, cosmology, and climate math.
stages.postdoc: AIMS Research Centre postdoctoral fellowships in epidemiology, climate modeling, and AI.
stages.assoc_prof: Volunteer as a 3-week visiting lecturer teaching specialized modules to Africa's top math students.
stages.prof: Hold AIMS Research Chairs (including German Research Chairs supported by Humboldt Foundation).

rabbitLinks.reason: AIMS graduates analyze petabytes of radio astronomy data from South Africa's MeerKAT and Square Kilometre Array.
Founded by cosmologist Neil Turok before he directed Perimeter Institute, creating a lasting Canada-Africa math bridge.
AIMS mathematical epidemiologists collaborate with South African genomic surveillance teams on infectious disease modeling.

projects.name: AI for Science Master's (with Google DeepMind) & Next Einstein Forum

hubs.name: Africa Health Research Institute (AHRI) & KRISP
hubs.summary: Unites Wellcome-funded AHRI with KRISP (KwaZulu-Natal Research Innovation and Sequencing Platform) in Durban—world-famous for real-time viral genomic surveillance (identifying Beta and Omicron variants), HIV cure immunology, and tuberculosis research.
hubs.nobel: Honored globally (Time100, Nature's 10) for transparent open-data pathogen genomics that alerted the world to SARS-CoV-2 variants in real time.

stages.highschool: Explore AHRI's KwaZulu-Natal community science engagement and genomics career portals.
stages.undergrad: UKZN & AHRI undergraduate biomedical honors research tracks.
stages.masters: MSc fellowships in bioinformatics, viral phylogenetics, and clinical immunology.
stages.phd: Fully funded AHRI-UCL and KRISP/CERI PhD fellowships building African genomic capacity.
stages.postdoc: SANTHE (Sub-Saharan African Network for TB/HIV Research Excellence) postdoctoral fellowships.
stages.assoc_prof: Faculty positions bridging rural population cohorts in Somkhele with BSL-3 immunology labs in Durban.
stages.prof: Global leadership in epidemic genomics, climate-sensitive infectious disease, and equitable biotech.

rabbitLinks.reason: Pairs South African real-time genomic surveillance with AIMS mathematical modeling of infectious outbreaks.
Both Wellcome-backed hubs collaborating on open global pathogen genomics.

projects.name: African Pathogen Genomic Surveillance & HIV/TB Immunology

events.title: Rhind Mathematical Papyrus: Egyptian Metrology, Slope & Mechanics
events.summary: Recorded 84 worked problems in arithmetic, geometric area/volume estimation, and the seked (incline ratio) used in precision surveying, solar alignment, and monumental engineering.
events.impact: Demonstrated systematic quantitative problem-solving and standardized physical measurement over a millennium before classical Greece.

events.title: Euclid's Elements & Axiomatic Geometry
events.summary: Compiled 13 books deriving plane and solid geometry plus elementary number theory (including the infinitude of primes) purely from five postulates and deductive logic.
events.impact: Established the axiomatic-deductive standard of mathematical proof that governed science for over two millennia.

events.title: Eratosthenes Measures Earth's Circumference
events.summary: Compared the summer solstice noon zenith Sun in Syene (Aswan) with a 7.2° shadow angle in Alexandria to calculate Earth's circumference to within a few percent of the true 40,075 km value.
events.impact: Founded mathematical geodesy and proved that planetary scales can be measured via simple geometric experiments.

events.title: Kitab al-Manazir (Book of Optics) & Experimental Method
events.summary: Proved via controlled camera obscura and pinhole experiments that vision occurs when light rays enter the eye from illuminated objects, analyzing reflection and refraction quantitatively.
events.impact: Pioneered systematic experimental verification and shaped European optics for six centuries.

events.title: Square Kilometre Array (SKAO) Full Science Operations
events.summary: Twin continental radio telescope arrays—197 dishes in South Africa (SKA-Mid) and 131,072 dipole antennas in Western Australia (SKA-Low)—delivering unprecedented radio sensitivity.
events.impact: Will map the Cosmic Dawn 21-cm hydrogen signal, test general relativity with pulsars, and probe cosmic magnetism.

trails.title: Decoding Life: From Heredity to Genomic AI
trails.tagline: Follow DNA from its discovery as genetic code through million-fold sequencing drops, CRISPR, and 40B-parameter genome models.

stops.title: The Rockefeller University
stops.bridge: In 1944, Avery, MacLeod, and McCarty proved here that DNA—not protein—is the molecule carrying genetic heredity.

stops.title: Wellcome Sanger Institute
stops.bridge: Using Frederick Sanger's chain-termination sequencing, decoded one-third of the Human Genome Project and established open global genomic data.

stops.title: Cambridge Dept. of Chemistry
stops.bridge: Just up the road, Balasubramanian and Klenerman invented Solexa/Illumina sequencing-by-synthesis—slashing whole-genome costs from $100M to under $200.

stops.title: Innovative Genomics Institute (CRISPR)
stops.bridge: Once biology could read genomes cheaply, Jennifer Doudna's CRISPR-Cas9 gave humanity the molecular word processor to edit DNA precisely.

stops.title: Arc Institute (Palo Alto)
stops.bridge: Now trains 40B-parameter genomic foundation models (Evo 2) across 9.3 trillion DNA bases to design novel genetic circuits and Virtual Cells.

stops.title: AHRI & KRISP (Durban)
stops.bridge: Brings high-speed genomics to global public health—tracking emerging viral variants in real time across Africa to protect the entire world.
